children.text: The chart below shows product and service revenue for each quarter of the current fiscal year. Product revenue (blue) consistently outpaces service revenue (orange) across all four quarters.

Product revenue grew 77.8 % year-over-year, reaching $22.14 M in Q4. Service revenue expanded 86.2 % over the same period to $5.38 M. Combined Q4 revenue of $27.52 M represents a 74.0 % increase over Q1.
